# BznsFlow

> BznsFlow builds and runs AI and automation for small and medium businesses in the GCC, starting in Oman, as a done-for-you service. What we offer today is Catalyst: Layla on WhatsApp and/or Instagram. Layla answers customer inquiries from the business facts the owner approves, asks the owner's qualifying questions, and hands the owner the conversation and the customer record, ready for the next step. The owner can take over any conversation at any time. Arabic first, with English alongside.

BznsFlow is a verified Meta Tech Provider (business verification, 2026-09-16).

## Catalyst (available now)

- Layla on WhatsApp and/or Instagram.
- Answers only from the business information and catalog the owner approves in BznsBrain; when she does not know, she gives the team's contact instead of guessing.
- Asks the owner's qualifying questions, one at a time.
- Every chat and customer record in the owner's dashboard; human takeover at any time.
- Customer data deletion on request.

Layla does not confirm bookings or promise sales. The written agreement for each business sets what is delivered.

## Plans

- **Catalyst** — available now.
- **Ascend** — in preparation, for answered inquiries that still need follow-up.
- **Apex** — in preparation, for inquiries spread across staff and branches.

Pricing is shared on the free audit, together with the agreed scope: a one-time setup and a monthly service, with a 90-day minimum. Messaging and AI usage are billed at cost.

## Scoped projects beyond Catalyst

Quoted separately in writing: customer acquisition systems, reorder journeys, loyalty journeys, WhatsApp and email outreach, websites, CRM and pipeline, automation and integrations, custom apps.

## What clients say (approved, verbatim)

- **Mawa Real Estate · مأوى (Muscat, Oman):** "Enquiries reach me already qualified, in the same sheet we already worked from. I stopped asking about budget on the first call — it's there before I dial."
- **BizBay · mybizbay.com (Bahrain):** "242 enquiries in two months, one missed. I used to answer between meetings. Now every one gets a reply in two seconds and I read the summary at 9pm." (One client, Twilio message logs, 6 June to 4 August 2026.)
- **Five Gates (Bahrain):** "Years of WhatsApp became one file per client. I stopped digging through threads to remember what we agreed."
- **Mekka Hijama:** "Our patients speak three languages. They all book the same way now — nobody calls to ask how to book any more."
- **Reading Jeel (Oman):** "I sell digital books without running any system. The order arrives and the file reaches the customer automatically."
- **Wild Muscat (Oman):** "The site reads Arabic-first, not translated. That's what we were after."
- **Royal Fish:** "Guests find the menu and they find the door. In two languages. That's all I needed it to do."

Each quote describes the project BznsFlow delivered for that business.
